reply_text:
I told Ilse in their DM that their Quarrendon Freight Lines dock is **Bay 30**, which they told me on 14 Oct, effective that day.

The private note I saved in gbrain on 14 Oct didn't come back: looking up Ilse's entry returned no facts. Its tool description says remote callers only get "world facts", so it probably doesn't return private notes to this connection. That's my guess, not something I confirmed. I got the answer from Ilse's own DM with me instead, which they can see anyway.

So I shouldn't count on gbrain to hold private notes like this. For now, the DM history is the record that actually works. If you want private notes to be retrievable, whoever owns the brain would need to check its visibility settings.
